Hi Anna — great to hear the team found the demo useful. Attached is a concise MAP and a separate pilot test plan (see MAP_HealthBridge_v1.xlsx and Pilot_test_plan_v2.docx). Summary of the proposed acceptance criteria and exit gates below so procurement has something to review quickly.

Proposed acceptance metrics (pass = meet or exceed all listed):
- Latency: 95th pctile tail <= 400 ms for 512-token end-to-end requests under a 5 qps sustained load with short bursts to 10 qps (production-like).
- Throughput: Consistent responses at 5 qps with <1% model error rate (OOMs, rejected requests).
- Quality: Automated compare on 300 seeded prompts: >= 85% match to expected intent/slot extraction thresholds OR no more than 10% semantic regressions measured by our similarity eval.
- Cost: Pilot monthly token estimate <= $X (see SOW_draft.pdf); Redwood will provide usage breakdown per-token by route.
- Security/compliance evidence: SOC2 attestation + audit log export (sample) delivered within 3 business days of request.

Exit/No-Go gates (any one triggers a no-go):
- Latency 95th > 500 ms for more than 2 nonconsecutive hours during test window.
- Quality regressions > 15% on seeded prompts vs baseline.
- Any reproducible data-exfiltration finding from basic vendor security scan.

Acceptance tests (hands-on):
- Perf run: 2-hour sustained run at 5 qps, 3x 10-min burst windows to 10 qps; capture p95, p99, and error rates.
- Quality run: Run 300-seed prompt set; compute pass rate and semantic-regression delta.
- Failover test: Simulate model variant fallback and confirm <2s additional latency on fallback.

Proposed timeline:
- Jul 21: Finalize MAP & SOW draft (this week).
- Jul 28: Pilot kickoff (data sync, endpoints, keys).
- Aug 1–Aug 3: Execute perf + quality test window.
- Aug 4: Go/No-Go decision meeting (stakeholders + procurement).

Owner & RACI notes:
- Redwood (Marcus): implement pilot endpoints, run perf tests, deliver logs and artifacts.
- HealthBridge (Anna): provide seed prompts, production-like load profile, procurement point of contact.
- Neha (sales): commercial lead and escalation.

I'll attach the files and link a draft SOW for procurement to review. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
